facts.text: Для Family Room указаны максимум 4 гостя и площадь 39–43 м² вместе с балконом.
Family Room описан как две спальни с соединяющей дверью.
Официальный Club Aqua Plaza: Standard Land View рассчитан максимум на2гостей,20–24м² включая балкон, спальня с French bed.
Superior Family Room имеет две спальни, 41–48 м² с балконом и вид на аквапарк; максимальная вместимость в источнике противоречива.
В перечне развлечений есть мини-клуб, детская анимация и игровая площадка.

material_limits.source_limitations_policy: An explicit empty source limitations string means no source-specific limitation was recorded. It is not evidence of unrestricted service; all sealed category, season, tariff and future-operation uncertainties remain applicable.
material_limits.temporal: Catalogue identity read25Oct2026 does not refresh property evidence read19–20Oct. Original publication/read/document-season fields remain intact; no validity period or expiry is invented. Exact travel-date room/tariff/service/availability remains unverified.
unknowns: Family Room39–43m2 including balcony/max4 with a connecting door is distinct from Standard Land View20–24m2/max2 and Superior Family41–48m2. No automatic room-code equivalence.
Superior Family's own page conflicts between4+1 and max4; five-person occupancy is not confirmed. Its source is retained as conflict context, not a new positive capacity claim.
A published four-guest Family maximum and two bedrooms do not establish child ages, a2AD+1CH tariff, guaranteed beds or availability of the purchased category.

Aqua Fun City access, slide age/height rules, winter operation/heating, soft or shallow sea entry and restaurant/meal rights are not established by these room records. Historical individual guest accounts are not current property guarantees.
